big_picture_notes: Proverbs is a divinely inspired anthology—multiple curated collections whose superscriptions provide the text‑driven framework. Its governing poetic device is parallelism (antithetical, synonymous, and synthetic), and its thematic center is 1:7: 'The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge.' The book moves from extended, thematic discourses (chs. 1–9) to dense couplets (10:1–22:16), to 'sayings of the wise' akin to ANE instruction (22:17–24:34), to a Hezekian Solomonic appendix (25–29), and concludes with Agur (30) and Lemuel (31). For memorization, treat each discrete discourse or themed proverb cluster as a scene; do not arbitrarily split complete poems.

stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Chs. 1–9 form an extended prologue of longer poems/discourses, contrasting Lady Wisdom and Folly. Start (1:1) titles the anthology; the section begins with 1:8 ('My son...') and ends at 9:18 with Folly's fatal feast, parallel to Wisdom's invitation (9:1–6). Literary Glue: repeated 'My son' addresses and the personifications of Wisdom and Folly.

scenes.scene_name: Prologue: The Purpose of the Proverbs
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The book's title and aim — Solomon's proverbs for gaining wisdom, discipline, and instruction in righteousness, justice, and equity.

scenes.scene_name: The Motto: The Fear of the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Prudence for the simple and knowledge for the young (4-6), sealed by the thematic key: 'the fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge' (7).

scenes.scene_name: A Father's Instruction: A Garland of Grace
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The first appeal: heed your father's instruction and your mother's teaching, a graceful garland and pendant.

scenes.scene_name: The Enticement of Sinners
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The seduction quoted: 'come, let us lie in wait for blood… throw in your lot with us.'

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Walk Their Road
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The warning: their feet run to evil, but they ambush their own lives — such is the fate of the greedy.

scenes.scene_name: Wisdom Cries Out in the Street
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Lady Wisdom's public plea: 'How long, O simple ones, will you love your simple ways?'

scenes.scene_name: Because You Refused My Call
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The turn to judgment: Wisdom's mockery of calamity when dread comes like a storm.

scenes.scene_name: They Will Call, but I Will Not Answer
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The harvest of refusal — eating the fruit of their own way — against the safety of whoever listens to Wisdom.

scenes.scene_name: If You Seek Wisdom Like Silver
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The opening 'if': accepting, inclining, calling out, and searching for wisdom like hidden treasure.

scenes.scene_name: Then You Will Find the Knowledge of God
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The first 'then': the LORD who gives wisdom and shields those who walk with integrity.

scenes.scene_name: Wisdom Will Enter Your Heart
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The second 'then': discernment of every good path, with discretion watching over you.

scenes.scene_name: Delivered from the Man of Perversity
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wisdom's first rescue: from those who leave the straight paths to walk in darkness.

scenes.scene_name: Rescued from the Forbidden Woman
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wisdom's second rescue: from the seductress whose house sinks down to death.

scenes.scene_name: The Upright Will Inhabit the Land
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The conclusion: walking in the ways of the good, for the wicked will be cut off from the land.

scenes.scene_name: Bind Loyalty and Faithfulness Around Your Neck
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Do not forget the teaching; love and faithfulness written on the heart bring favor with God and man.

scenes.scene_name: Trust in the LORD with All Your Heart
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The book's most-loved couplet: lean not on your own understanding, and He will make your paths straight.

scenes.scene_name: Honor the LORD with Your Wealth
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Firstfruits that fill the barns (9-10) and the discipline of the LORD who corrects the son He loves (11-12).

scenes.scene_name: Blessed Is the Man Who Finds Wisdom
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wisdom more profitable than silver, more precious than rubies — nothing compares with her.

scenes.scene_name: A Tree of Life
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Long life, riches, and honor in her hands; her ways pleasant, her paths peace.

scenes.scene_name: The LORD Founded the Earth by Wisdom
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The cosmic note: by wisdom and understanding the heavens and depths were established.

scenes.scene_name: Preserve Sound Judgment
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Sound judgment as life and adornment, giving safe steps and sweet, unafraid sleep.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Withhold Good
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: No fear of sudden ruin (25-26); the command to do good to the deserving when it is in your power (27-28).

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Envy the Violent Man
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A cluster of neighbor-ethics, for the LORD detests the perverse but befriends the upright.

scenes.scene_name: The Curse on the Wicked, Grace to the Humble
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing contrast: the LORD's curse and blessing, mocking mockers but giving grace to the humble.

scenes.scene_name: A Father's Story: My Father Taught Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The grandfather's voice passed down — 'let your heart lay hold of my words; keep my commands and you will live.'

scenes.scene_name: Get Wisdom: She Will Exalt You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The refrain to acquire wisdom above all, who sets a garland of grace and a crown of beauty on your head.

scenes.scene_name: The Way of Wisdom
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Guided on straight paths with unimpeded steps — 'hold on to instruction… for it is your life.'

scenes.scene_name: Two Paths: Dawn and Darkness
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The path of the wicked (14-17) against the path of the righteous, shining brighter until midday (18-19).

scenes.scene_name: Guard Your Heart, the Spring of Life
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The center of the chapter: keep the words within, for from the heart flow the springs of life.

scenes.scene_name: Fix Your Gaze Straight Ahead
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The whole-body charge: put away deceitful speech, look forward, and turn your feet from evil.

scenes.scene_name: The Honey of the Forbidden Woman
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Her lips drip honey but end bitter as wormwood; her feet go down to death.

scenes.scene_name: Keep Your Path Far from Her
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The warning not to approach her door, lest strangers feast on your vigor and wealth.

scenes.scene_name: The Groan at the End
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The deathbed regret: 'how I hated discipline… I am on the brink of utter ruin.'

scenes.scene_name: Drink from Your Own Cistern
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The positive call to marital joy: rejoice in the wife of your youth, a loving doe.

scenes.scene_name: The LORD Examines All His Paths
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Why be captivated by an adulteress, when a man's ways are before the eyes of the LORD?

scenes.scene_name: Free Yourself from Surety
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The first practical warning: if trapped by a pledge, free yourself like a gazelle from the hunter.

scenes.scene_name: Go to the Ant, O Slacker
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The second warning, against sloth: the ant gathers food in summer without any overseer.

scenes.scene_name: A Little Sleep, a Little Slumber
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The sluggard's poverty coming on like a robber.

scenes.scene_name: The Worthless Troublemaker
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The third warning: the perverse man who sows discord will be suddenly shattered.

scenes.scene_name: Seven Things the LORD Hates
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The numbered list (six… seven): haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed blood, and one who stirs up discord.

scenes.scene_name: A Lamp and a Light
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Keep your father's commandment bound on the heart, for it guides, watches, and speaks — the way to life.

scenes.scene_name: The Smooth Tongue of the Adulteress
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The purpose of the lamp: to keep you from the evil woman who preys on your very life.

scenes.scene_name: Can a Man Embrace Fire?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The rhetorical warning: as fire burns and coals scorch, so none who touches his neighbor's wife goes unpunished.

scenes.scene_name: The Thief and the Adulterer
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The contrast: even a thief pays restitution, but the adulterer destroys himself.

scenes.scene_name: Jealousy Enrages a Husband
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The unappeasable wrath and indelible reproach that follow adultery.

scenes.scene_name: Keep My Words as the Apple of Your Eye
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The frame: treasure the commandments, calling wisdom 'sister,' to be kept from the seductress.

scenes.scene_name: The Young Man Lacking Judgment
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The scene observed through the lattice: a simple youth crossing toward her corner at twilight.

scenes.scene_name: The Woman Comes to Meet Him
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The harlot's bold approach, loud and defiant, seizing and kissing him.

scenes.scene_name: I Have Decked My Bed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Her seduction: peace offerings paid, the bed perfumed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

scenes.scene_name: Come, Let Us Take Our Fill
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The lure of the absent husband gone on a long journey with a bag of money.

scenes.scene_name: Like an Ox to the Slaughter
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: His sudden surrender, not knowing it will cost him his life.

scenes.scene_name: Her House Is the Road to Sheol
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing appeal: do not stray into her paths, for her house descends to the chambers of death.

scenes.scene_name: Wisdom Calls at the Crossroads
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Lady Wisdom's public summons from the heights and the city gates to all the sons of men.

scenes.scene_name: I Speak Noble Things
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Her trustworthy words: righteous, plain to the discerning, with nothing crooked or perverse.

scenes.scene_name: More Precious Than Rubies
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wisdom to be received instead of silver and gold, beyond all you desire.

scenes.scene_name: By Me Kings Reign
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wisdom dwelling with prudence (12-13); counsel and strength hers, by which rulers govern justly (14-16).

scenes.scene_name: Riches and Honor Are with Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: 'I love those who love me'; her enduring wealth and righteousness bestowed on those who seek her.

scenes.scene_name: The LORD Possessed Me at the Beginning
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wisdom's pre-creation origin: brought forth before the depths, the mountains, and the dust of the earth.

scenes.scene_name: I Was There When He Established the Heavens
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wisdom present at creation — the skilled craftsman at His side, His daily delight, rejoicing in the world.

scenes.scene_name: Blessed Is the One Who Finds Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing appeal: watching daily at her doors brings life and the LORD's favor; to hate her is to love death.

scenes.scene_name: The Feast of Wisdom
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wisdom's house of seven pillars, her table set, calling the simple: 'Come, eat my bread… and you will live.'

scenes.scene_name: Rebuke a Wise Man and He Will Love You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The interlude on teachability: the mocker hates correction, but the wise grow wiser still.

scenes.scene_name: The Fear of the LORD Is the Beginning of Wisdom
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The book's motto restated, with wisdom multiplying days and the scoffer bearing his own consequences.

scenes.scene_name: The Feast of Folly
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The dark mirror: Lady Folly's identical call, whose stolen-water feast leads to the depths of Sheol.

stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Primary Solomonic couplets collection marked by 10:1 ('The proverbs of Solomon') and ending at 22:16 before a new heading (22:17). Literary Glue: pervasive antithetical parallelism and thematic contrasts (wise/foolish, righteous/wicked, diligent/slothful, wealth/poverty).

scenes.scene_name: A Wise Son and the Way of the Righteous
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The Solomonic collection opens with antithetical couplets: the wise son, ill-gotten gain, diligent hands, and blessings on the head of the righteous.

scenes.scene_name: Love Covers All Transgressions
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Speech and integrity: the rotting name of the wicked, the secure walk of integrity, and love that covers offenses.

scenes.scene_name: When Words Are Many, Sin Is Unavoidable
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wisdom on the lips, wealth and labor, and the restraint of speech against concealed hatred.

scenes.scene_name: The Blessing of the LORD Enriches
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The tongue of the righteous as choice silver, the LORD's enriching blessing, and the dread of the wicked.

scenes.scene_name: The Righteous Stand Forever
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The whirlwind that sweeps the wicked away, the fear of the LORD that prolongs life, and the joy of the righteous.

scenes.scene_name: The Way of the LORD Is a Refuge
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Refuge for the upright, the unshakeable righteous, and the mouth that brings forth wisdom.

scenes.scene_name: Dishonest Scales and the Guiding of Integrity
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The LORD's delight in honest weights, disgrace following pride, and righteousness delivering from death.

scenes.scene_name: When the Righteous Thrive, the City Rejoices
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The perishing hope of the wicked, the mouth that destroys a neighbor, and the prudent man who stays silent.

scenes.scene_name: A Gossip Reveals a Secret
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Trustworthy confidence, the safety of many counselors, the gracious woman, and the kind man who benefits himself.

scenes.scene_name: He Who Sows Righteousness Reaps Reward
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The blameless as God's delight, the gold ring in a pig's snout, and the paradox of the giver who gains more.

scenes.scene_name: A Generous Soul Will Prosper
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Refreshing others to be refreshed, the cursed hoarder, and the wicked who trust in riches and fall.

scenes.scene_name: The Fruit of the Righteous Is a Tree of Life
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Inheriting the wind, winning souls, and the certainty that all receive their due on earth.

scenes.scene_name: Whoever Loves Discipline Loves Knowledge
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The love of correction, the noble wife as her husband's crown, and the just plans of the righteous.

scenes.scene_name: The House of the Righteous Will Stand
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The overthrown wicked, the man praised for wisdom, and the righteous who regards even his animal's life.

scenes.scene_name: The Tongue of the Wise Brings Healing
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The fool right in his own eyes against the wise who listens, and rash speech that pierces like a sword.

scenes.scene_name: Truthful Lips Endure Forever
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The momentary lying tongue, the joy of peacemakers, and the diligent hand that comes to rule.

scenes.scene_name: A Good Word Cheers the Heart
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Anxiety lifted by a kind word, caution in friendship, and life found in the path of righteousness.

scenes.scene_name: He Who Guards His Mouth Protects His Life
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The wise son who heeds discipline, the diligent soul satisfied, and righteousness that guards the man of integrity.

scenes.scene_name: Hope Deferred Makes the Heart Sick
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Pretended wealth and poverty, the shining light of the righteous, and desire fulfilled as a tree of life.

scenes.scene_name: The Teaching of the Wise Is a Fountain of Life
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Reward for respecting the command, the prudent acting with knowledge, and honor for those who heed correction.

scenes.scene_name: Walk with the Wise and Become Wise
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The companion of fools destroyed, disaster pursuing sinners, and the good man's lasting inheritance.

scenes.scene_name: He Who Loves His Son Disciplines Him
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Food in the fallow ground of the poor, the rod of love, and the satisfied appetite of the righteous.

scenes.scene_name: The Wise Woman Builds Her House
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The wise woman against the foolish, the fear of the LORD in upright walking, and the honest witness.

scenes.scene_name: A Way That Seems Right to a Man
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Avoiding the fool, the heart that knows its own bitterness, and the path that ends in death.

scenes.scene_name: Even in Laughter the Heart May Ache
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The mixed heart, the simple who believe everything, and the prudent crowned with knowledge.

scenes.scene_name: Blessed Is He Who Is Kind to the Poor
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The poor hated by neighbors, the profit of labor over mere talk, and kindness rewarded with devotion.

scenes.scene_name: The Fear of the LORD Is a Fountain of Life
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The truthful witness who saves lives, the secure refuge of the God-fearer, and the patient, tranquil heart.

scenes.scene_name: Righteousness Exalts a Nation
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Honoring the Maker by kindness to the needy, the refuge of the righteous in death, and the king's delight in a wise servant.

scenes.scene_name: A Gentle Answer Turns Away Wrath
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The soothing tongue as a tree of life, the all-seeing eyes of the LORD, and the treasure in the house of the righteous.

scenes.scene_name: The Prayer of the Upright Is His Delight
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The detestable sacrifice of the wicked, the LORD's love for those who pursue righteousness, and Sheol laid open before Him.

scenes.scene_name: A Cheerful Heart Has a Continual Feast
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Better a little with the fear of the LORD, a dish of vegetables with love, and the slow-to-anger who calms dispute.

scenes.scene_name: The Path of the Upright Is a Highway
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Plans failing for lack of counsel, the joy of a timely word, and the path of life leading upward for the wise.

scenes.scene_name: The LORD Hears the Prayer of the Righteous
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The proud man's house torn down, the widow's boundary protected, and good news that nourishes the bones.

scenes.scene_name: Humility Comes Before Honor
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Heeding life-giving reproof, the fear of the LORD as wisdom's instruction, and humility before honor.

scenes.scene_name: Commit Your Works to the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Man plans but the LORD gives the reply; motives weighed; everything made for His purpose; iniquity atoned by devotion.

scenes.scene_name: The LORD Determines His Steps
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Enemies made peaceable, better a little with righteousness, and the throne established through righteousness.

scenes.scene_name: Pride Goes Before Destruction
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The king's favor like spring rain, wisdom better than gold, the highway of the upright, and the famous warning of pride before a fall.

scenes.scene_name: Pleasant Words Are a Honeycomb
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Lowliness with the humble, the blessing of trusting the LORD, and sweet, healing speech from a wise heart.

scenes.scene_name: A Worthless Man Digs Up Evil
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The way that seems right, the worker's driving hunger, and the perverse who spreads dissension and divides friends.

scenes.scene_name: Better Than One Who Captures a City
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Gray hair a crown of glory, the slow-to-anger greater than a warrior, and the lot whose decision is from the LORD.

scenes.scene_name: Better a Dry Morsel in Peace
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Quietness over feasting with strife, the LORD as tester of hearts, and grandchildren the crown of the aged.

scenes.scene_name: Whoever Conceals an Offense Promotes Love
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The bribe-charm, the rebuke that cuts the discerning deep, and the danger of meeting a fool in his folly.

scenes.scene_name: A Friend Loves at All Times
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Evil never leaving the house that returns evil for good, the released flood of a quarrel, and the brother born for adversity.

scenes.scene_name: A Joyful Heart Is Good Medicine
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The lover of strife, the grief of fathering a fool, and wisdom as the focus of the discerning.

scenes.scene_name: Even a Fool Is Thought Wise If Silent
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The grief of a foolish son, the man of knowledge who restrains his words, and the value of holding the tongue.

scenes.scene_name: A Fool Delights Only in His Opinions
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The self-isolating man, the deep waters of the mouth, and the partiality that deprives the innocent of justice.

scenes.scene_name: The Name of the LORD Is a Strong Tower
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The fool's mouth as his ruin, the gossip's choice morsels, and the strong tower to which the righteous run.

scenes.scene_name: Answer a Matter After You Hear It
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The folly of answering before hearing, the discerning heart that acquires knowledge, and the lot that ends quarrels.

scenes.scene_name: A Friend Closer Than a Brother
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The offended brother harder to win than a fortress, life and death in the tongue, and the loyal friend.

scenes.scene_name: Better a Poor Man of Integrity
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Zeal without knowledge, folly that subverts a man's way, and wealth that attracts fair-weather friends.

scenes.scene_name: A Man's Insight Gives Him Patience
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The deserted poor man, wisdom as self-love, and the virtue of overlooking an offense.

scenes.scene_name: A Prudent Wife Is from the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The quarrelsome wife like constant dripping, kindness to the poor as a loan to the LORD, and the hope in disciplining a son.

scenes.scene_name: The Fear of the LORD Leads to Life
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The hot-tempered who must pay, the many plans against the LORD's prevailing purpose, and the contentment of the God-fearer.

scenes.scene_name: Strike a Mocker, and the Simple Beware
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The discerning who gains from rebuke, the shameful son who assaults his parents, and judgments prepared for mockers.

scenes.scene_name: Wine Is a Mocker
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Strong drink the brawler, the lion-terror of a king, and the deep waters of the heart that understanding draws out.

scenes.scene_name: The Righteous Walk in Integrity
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The king who sifts evil with his eyes, the question 'who can say I am pure?', and the ears and eyes the LORD has made.

scenes.scene_name: Lips of Knowledge Are a Rare Treasure
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The poverty of loving sleep, the buyer who gloats, and food gained by fraud that turns to gravel.

scenes.scene_name: Wait on the LORD, and He Will Save You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The babbling gossip, the extinguished lamp of one who curses parents, and steps that are from the LORD.

scenes.scene_name: The Spirit of Man Is the Lamp of the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The trap of rash vows, the king who threshes out the wicked, and devotion and faithfulness that preserve a throne.

scenes.scene_name: The King's Heart Is in the Hand of the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The waterway-heart God directs, righteousness desired over sacrifice, and the diligent plans that bring plenty.

scenes.scene_name: Better a Corner of the Roof
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The crooked way of the guilty, the corner of the roof over a quarrelsome wife, and the Righteous One who considers the wicked.

scenes.scene_name: Justice Is a Joy to the Righteous
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Shutting the ears to the poor, the joy of justice executed, and the lover of pleasure who grows poor.

scenes.scene_name: He Who Guards His Mouth Keeps His Soul
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The desert over a contentious wife, the wise man who scales a city, and the guarded mouth that avoids distress.

scenes.scene_name: The Righteous Give Without Restraint
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The slacker's deadly craving, the detestable sacrifice of the wicked, and the perishing lying witness.

scenes.scene_name: Victory Is of the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The hardened face of the wicked, no wisdom prevailing against the LORD, and the horse prepared but victory the LORD's.

scenes.scene_name: A Good Name Is to Be Chosen
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A good name above riches, the LORD as Maker of rich and poor, and the rewards of humility and the fear of the LORD.

scenes.scene_name: Train Up a Child in the Way He Should Go
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The borrower as the lender's slave, the blessed generous man, and the friend the king makes of the pure in heart.

scenes.scene_name: The Rod of Discipline Drives Out Folly
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The slacker's imagined lion, the adulteress's deep pit, and the discipline that drives folly from a child — closing Solomon's collection.

stories.story_title: The Thirty Sayings of the Wise
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: New headings at 22:17 ('Incline your ear to the words of the wise') and 24:23 ('These also are sayings of the wise') mark a distinct curated collection. Style shifts from couplets to multi‑line sayings akin to ANE instruction (cf. Amenemope).

scenes.scene_name: Preamble: The Thirty Sayings
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The 'words of the wise' open: incline your ear and apply your mind — 'have I not written for you thirty sayings?'

scenes.scene_name: Saying 1-2: The Poor and the Angry Man
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Do not rob the poor at the gate, and do not befriend a hot-tempered man, lest you learn his ways.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 3-5: Pledges, Boundaries, and Skilled Work
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Avoid rash pledges, do not move the ancient boundary, and the skilled worker will stand before kings.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 6: Dining with a Ruler
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Consider carefully what is set before you — 'put a knife to your throat,' for the food is deceptive.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 7: Do Not Wear Yourself Out to Get Rich
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wealth sprouts wings and flies away like an eagle.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 8: The Stingy Host
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Do not eat the bread of one who inwardly counts the cost; you will only vomit it up.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 9-10: The Fool and the Fatherless
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Do not speak to a fool, and do not encroach on the fields of the fatherless, whose Redeemer is strong.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 11: Do Not Withhold Discipline
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Apply your heart to instruction; the rod will deliver a child's soul from Sheol.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 12: My Son, If Your Heart Is Wise
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A father's joy at right speech, and the charge to envy not sinners but continue in the fear of the LORD.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 13: Avoid Drunkards and Gluttons
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Guide your heart on the right course, for the drunkard and glutton come to poverty.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 14: Buy Truth and Do Not Sell It
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Listen to your father and mother, invest in wisdom, and let your parents rejoice over you.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 15: My Son, Give Me Your Heart
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The warning against the prostitute, a deep pit who multiplies the faithless.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 16: Who Has Woe?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The riddle of wine's misery — do not gaze at it when it sparkles red in the cup.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 16 cont.: It Bites Like a Snake
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Wine's end: hallucinations, numbness to blows, and the addict's craving to wake and drink again.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 17-18: By Wisdom a House Is Built
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Do not envy wicked men; by wisdom and knowledge a house is built and filled with treasure.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 19-21: A Wise Man Is Strong
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Strength in counsel, wisdom too high for a fool, and the schemer detested by all.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 22: Rescue Those Led Away to Death
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The duty to deliver the doomed, for the One who weighs hearts repays each according to his deeds.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 23-24: Wisdom Is Sweet to Your Soul
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Honey-sweet wisdom giving a future, and the righteous who fall seven times yet rise again.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 25-26: Do Not Gloat When Your Enemy Falls
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: No rejoicing at a foe's stumble, and no fretting over evildoers whose lamp will be snuffed out.

scenes.scene_name: Saying 27: Fear the LORD and the King
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Avoid the rebellious, for sudden destruction comes from both.

scenes.scene_name: Further Sayings: Impartial Judgment
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: An appendix of the wise: partiality condemned, and an honest answer like a kiss on the lips.

scenes.scene_name: Prepare Your Field; Do Not Repay Evil
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Order your work before building, do not bear false witness, and do not say 'I will repay him.'

scenes.scene_name: The Sluggard's Overgrown Field
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The closing parable: the lesson learned from the lazy man's thorn-choked vineyard and broken wall.

stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Explicit editorial title at 25:1; style returns to clustered couplets with many similes/comparisons and court‑wisdom. Concludes the fourth major collection at 29:27.

scenes.scene_name: The Glory of Kings to Search a Matter Out
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Hezekiah's men copied these proverbs of Solomon: God's glory to conceal, and the unsearchable hearts of kings.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Exalt Yourself Before the King
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Remove the dross and the wicked, and take the lower place — better 'come up here' than to be demoted.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Go Hastily to Court
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Settle disputes privately without betraying a confidence, lest your infamy never depart.

scenes.scene_name: Apples of Gold in Settings of Silver
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A word fitly spoken, a wise rebuke, a trustworthy messenger, and the gentle tongue that breaks a bone.

scenes.scene_name: Seldom Set Foot in Your Neighbor's House
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Moderation in honey and visits, the false witness like a weapon, and songs sung to a heavy heart.

scenes.scene_name: Coals of Fire on His Head
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Feeding your hungry enemy heaps coals on his head, and the LORD will reward you (cited in Rom 12).

scenes.scene_name: A Man Without Self-Control
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The quarrelsome wife, good news like cold water, and the man without self-control like a city with broken walls.

scenes.scene_name: Honor Does Not Befit a Fool
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Snow in summer, the undeserved curse that does not land, and the rod for the backs of fools.

scenes.scene_name: Answer a Fool According to His Folly
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The paradox-pair on answering fools, and the danger of a proverb or message in a fool's hand.

scenes.scene_name: A Dog Returns to Its Vomit
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The fool repeating his folly, and worse hope for the man wise in his own eyes.

scenes.scene_name: The Sluggard's Excuses
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: 'A lion in the road!'; the sluggard turning on his bed like a door on its hinges, too lazy to feed himself.

scenes.scene_name: Whoever Meddles in a Quarrel
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Grabbing a dog by the ears, the deceiver who says 'I was only joking,' and the fire that dies without wood.

scenes.scene_name: A Quarrelsome Man Kindles Strife
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Charcoal for embers, the gossip's choice morsels, and the hateful heart glazed over with smooth speech.

scenes.scene_name: A Lying Tongue Hates Its Victims
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Do not believe the gracious-speaking hater, for he who digs a pit falls into it.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Boast About Tomorrow
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Let another praise you, and the cruelty of wrath against which jealousy is even more overwhelming.

scenes.scene_name: Faithful Are the Wounds of a Friend
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Open rebuke better than hidden love, and the full soul that loathes even honey.

scenes.scene_name: Better a Neighbor Nearby Than a Brother Far
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The straying bird, the sweetness of a friend's counsel, and loyalty in the day of calamity.

scenes.scene_name: The Prudent See Danger and Take Cover
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Be wise and gladden your father, take collateral for surety, and the over-loud blessing counted a curse.

scenes.scene_name: Iron Sharpens Iron
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The contentious woman like constant dripping, and the friend who sharpens a man as iron sharpens iron.

scenes.scene_name: A Man Is Tested by His Praise
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Tending a fig tree, the heart reflecting the man as water reflects a face, and the crucible of praise.

scenes.scene_name: Know the State of Your Flocks
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The fool's ineradicable folly (22), and the husbandman's wisdom of tending flocks, for riches are not forever (23-27).

scenes.scene_name: The Righteous Are as Bold as a Lion
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The fleeing wicked, the stability of an understanding leader, and those who forsake versus keep the law.

scenes.scene_name: Better a Poor Man of Integrity
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Those who seek the LORD understand justice, and the discerning son who keeps the law.

scenes.scene_name: Whoever Turns His Ear from the Law
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Usurious wealth passed to the kind, the detestable prayer of the lawless, and the trap of one's own pit.

scenes.scene_name: He Who Confesses His Sins Finds Mercy
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The poor man who sees through the rich, and the blessing of confession and constant reverence.

scenes.scene_name: A Wicked Ruler Over a Helpless People
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The roaring-lion ruler, the oppressor lacking judgment, and the safety of those who walk with integrity.

scenes.scene_name: A Faithful Man Abounds with Blessings
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Working the land for plenty, and the punishment awaiting the one greedy to get rich quick.

scenes.scene_name: He Who Trusts in the LORD Will Prosper
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Rebuke that finds more favor than flattery, and the greedy who stir up strife.

scenes.scene_name: Whoever Gives to the Poor Will Not Want
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The folly of self-trust, blessing for the generous, and the righteous flourishing when the wicked perish.

scenes.scene_name: When the Righteous Flourish, the People Rejoice
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The stiff-necked suddenly shattered, the wisdom-lover's joy, and the king who brings stability by justice.

scenes.scene_name: The Righteous Consider the Cause of the Poor
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The flatterer's net, the evil man snared by sin, and the righteous mindful of the poor.

scenes.scene_name: A Fool Vents All His Anger
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Mockers inflaming a city against the wise who turn away anger, and the fool who pours out his rage.

scenes.scene_name: The Rod of Correction Imparts Wisdom
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The ruler corrupted by lies, the king whose fair judgment endures, and the rod that imparts wisdom.

scenes.scene_name: Where There Is No Vision, the People Cast Off Restraint
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The increase of rebellion under the wicked, and the blessing of keeping the Law.

scenes.scene_name: An Angry Man Stirs Up Dissension
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The servant unmoved by words, the man hasty in speech, and the hot-tempered abounding in transgression.

scenes.scene_name: The Fear of Man Is a Snare
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Pride bringing low and humility raising up, the snare of the fear of man, and justice that comes from the LORD.

stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Ch. 30 stands as a self‑contained appendix by Agur son of Jakeh, featuring confessional humility, prayer for moderation, and a series of numerical proverbs.

scenes.scene_name: Agur's Confession of Ignorance
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The words of Agur: 'I am weary… surely I am the most ignorant of men,' with no knowledge of the Holy One.

scenes.scene_name: Who Has Ascended to Heaven?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The unanswerable questions about the Creator and His Son, and the flawless, untouchable word of God.

scenes.scene_name: Give Me Neither Poverty nor Riches
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The two requests: falsehood removed and a portion of daily bread, lest plenty deny God or poverty profane Him.

scenes.scene_name: Four Cursed Generations
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A numbered cluster: generations that curse parents, are proud in their own filth, haughty-eyed, and devour the poor.

scenes.scene_name: The Leech and the Insatiable Four
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The leech's daughters and four that never say 'Enough' — Sheol, the barren womb, dry land, and fire.

scenes.scene_name: Four Ways Too Wonderful to Understand
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The eagle, the snake, the ship, and the way of a man with a maiden — and the unblushing adulteress.

scenes.scene_name: Four Things the Earth Cannot Bear
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The unbearable reversals: a servant who becomes king, a fool well-fed, and a maidservant who supplants her mistress.

scenes.scene_name: Four Small but Exceedingly Wise
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The ants, the rock badgers, the locusts, and the lizard — small creatures of great wisdom.

scenes.scene_name: Four Stately in Their Stride
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The lion, the rooster, the he-goat, and the king — closing on the warning that stirring anger brings forth strife.

stories.story_title: The Words of Lemuel and The Excellent Wife
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Ch. 31 is the closing appendix attributed to King Lemuel: his mother's oracle on kingship (31:1–9) followed by the acrostic 'excellent wife' (31:10–31). Literary Glue: alphabetic acrostic binding the final poem and thematic fear‑of‑the‑LORD center.

scenes.scene_name: The Oracle King Lemuel's Mother Taught Him
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A queen-mother's counsel to her son: do not spend your strength on women who ruin kings.

scenes.scene_name: It Is Not for Kings to Drink Wine
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The warning against royal drunkenness that forgets justice, and strong drink reserved for the perishing.

scenes.scene_name: Speak Up for the Voiceless
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The king's charge to open his mouth and defend the cause of the poor and dispossessed.

scenes.scene_name: The Excellent Wife: Her Worth and Work
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The acrostic poem opens: a wife more precious than rubies, trusted, industrious, rising while it is still night.

scenes.scene_name: She Plants a Vineyard
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Her enterprise: appraising a field, girding herself with strength, her lamp not going out at night.

scenes.scene_name: She Reaches Out to the Needy
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Her hands at the spindle and open to the poor, her household clothed without fear of snow.

scenes.scene_name: Strength and Honor Are Her Clothing
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Her honored husband at the gates, her wise speech, and her watchful, unidle household management.

scenes.scene_name: Her Children Call Her Blessed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The crown of the book: 'a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised' — let her works praise her at the gates.
